rationale.hitl-workflow: PRV makes human verification a defined pre-merge lifecycle checkpoint.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Verify explicitly uses linting and lightweight automated tests.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Prompt logs and tagged commits preserve auditable generation and revision history.
rationale.quality-debt: Refactoring directly targets maintainability debt, readability, duplication, and architectural consistency.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes automation-maximalist agentic workflows by retaining accountable human control.
